# PointBlank Swarm

Godot 4.7 GDScript VR game for the HTC VIVE XR Elite (Android, OpenXR). GPL-3.0-or-later.

## Where things are
- Game code: godot/game (engine layer), godot/core (engine-free rules), godot/tests (headless tests)
- Project settings: godot/project.godot, godot/export_presets.cfg, godot/openxr_action_map.tres
- Third-party assets: godot/assets/manifest.json (URLs, checksums, licences, generators). Attribution: godot/assets/CREDITS.md
- Asset candidates and status: docs/free-assets.md. Project overview, controls and setup: README.md

## Downloading and building assets
- List: python3 scripts/fetch_assets.py --list
- Dry run (changes nothing, downloads nothing): python3 scripts/fetch_assets.py --dry-run
- Fetch and build: python3 scripts/fetch_assets.py   (downloads missing or changed files and builds missing generated ones)
- Re-fetch: python3 scripts/fetch_assets.py --force   (add --only ID, repeatable, to limit it, e.g. --only music.battle --only music.hub)
- Generated entry: godot/assets/audio/amb.menu.wav (the pregame menu ambience) is built, not downloaded. When it is missing,
  fetch runs scripts/gen_menu_ambience.py, which needs numpy (pip install numpy). The script prints the sha256 it produced;
  record that value in the amb.menu entry of the manifest.
- Only licences on the manifest allowlist are fetched or built: CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0, MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause,
  BSD-3-Clause, Public-Domain, project-owned (generated in this repo).
- Files must go inside godot/assets/. Generators must be scripts inside scripts/. Each download entry needs a sha256; the
  script reports the value to add when it is missing.
- CC-BY-4.0 entries need a source_url. CREDITS.md then gives the author, source URL, track URL and licence URL.
- Every non-dry-run fetch rewrites godot/assets/CREDITS.md from the manifest, so do not edit it by hand.

## Checks
- Core rule tests: godot --headless --path godot -s res://tests/core_checks.gd
  Prints one ok or FAIL line per check, then "N passed, M failed". Exits 0 on success, 1 on failure.
- Headless smoke: godot --headless --path godot -- --smoke
  Prints "SMOKE PASSED" or "SMOKE FAILED: n". Exits 0 on success, 1 on failure.
- Parse one script without running the game: godot --headless --path godot --check-only --script res://game/controls.gd
- Asset manifest check: python3 scripts/fetch_assets.py --list (prints every manifest entry with its licence and path)

## Build and deploy
- Android APK, install and launch: GODOT=/path/to/godot scripts/deploy_android.sh
- Vendor plugin (HTC passthrough): scripts/fetch_openxr_vendors.sh
- On-device benchmark: scripts/benchmark_pull.sh results.csv writes two files. results.csv holds the samples
  (header elapsed_s,alive,visible,avg_frame_ms,graphics_tier). results.result.csv holds the device and the RESULT row
  (header device,alive,visible,graphics_tier,budget_ms,stop_code; header only until the run finishes).
